arxiv-2101-07567.title: α \alpha -cluster formation in heavy α \alpha -emitters within a multistep model
arxiv-2101-07567.creator: J. M. Dong, Q. Zhao, L. J. Wang, W. Zuo, J. Z. Gu
arxiv-2101-07567.description: Abstract α \alpha -decay always has enormous impetuses to the development of physics and chemistry, in particular due to its indispensable role in the research of new elements. Although it has been observed in laboratories for more than a century, it remains a difficult problem to calculate accurately the formation probability S α S_{\alpha} microscopically.

arxiv-2105-09411.title: Analysis of long-term transients and detection of early warning signs of major population changes in a two-timescale ecosystem.
arxiv-2105-09411.creator: Susmita Sadhu
arxiv-2105-09411.description: Abstract . Identifying early warning signs of sudden population changes and mechanisms leading to regime shifts are highly desirable in population biology. In this paper, a two-trophic ecosystem comprising of two species of predators, competing for their common prey, with explicit interference competition is considered.

arxiv-2202-05749.title: Constrained Optimization with Dynamic Bound-scaling for Effective NLP Backdoor Defense
arxiv-2202-05749.creator: Guangyu Shen, Yingqi Liu, Guanhong Tao, Qiuling Xu, Zhuo Zhang, Shengwei An, Shiqing Ma, Xiangyu Zhang
arxiv-2202-05749.description: Abstract We develop a novel optimization method for NLP backdoor inversion. We leverage a dynamically reducing temperature coefficient in the softmax function to provide changing loss landscapes to the optimizer such that the process gradually focuses on the ground truth trigger, which is denoted as a one-hot value in a convex hull.

arxiv-2401-05403.title: The Key Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Early Childhood Education: A Review
arxiv-2401-05403.creator: Yi Honghu, Liu Ting ID, Lan Gongjin ID
arxiv-2401-05403.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies have been applied in various domains, including early childhood education (ECE). Integration of AI educational technology is a recent significant trend in ECE. Currently, there are more and more studies of AI in ECE. To date, there is a lack of survey articles that discuss the studies of AI in ECE.

arxiv-2401-16058.title: Neuromorphic Valence and Arousal Estimation
arxiv-2401-16058.creator: Lorenzo Berlincioni, Luca Cultrera, Federico Becattini, Alberto Del Bimbo
arxiv-2401-16058.description: Abstract Recognizing faces and their underlying emotions is an important aspect of biometrics. In fact, estimating emotional states from faces has been tackled from several angles in the literature. In this paper, we follow the novel route of using neuromorphic data to predict valence and arousal values from faces.

arxiv-2404-18075.title: Comparing E-bike and Conventional Bicycle Use Patterns in a Public Bike Share System: A Case Study of Richmond, VA Journal: Journal of Cycling and Micromobility
arxiv-2404-18075.creator: Yifan Yang, Elliott Sloate, Nashid Khadem, Celeste Chavis, Ph.D., P.E, Vanessa Frías-Martínez, Ph.D
arxiv-2404-18075.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yifan Yang, Elliott Sloate, Nashid Khadem, Celeste Chavis, Ph.D., P.E, Vanessa Frías-Martínez, Ph.D. \textcolor blackBicycle-sharing systems have emerged as a viable transportation alternative in numerous urban areas, owing to their multifaceted benefits. These benefits include reduced transportation expenses, health improvements, and decreased emission levels. While extensive research has been conducted on travel behaviors in shared bicycle systems, there is currently a lack of research on travel behaviors changes with the introduction of e-bikes.

arxiv-2502-06314.title: From Pixels to Components: Eigenvector Masking for Visual Representation Learning
arxiv-2502-06314.creator: Alice Bizeul 1,2, Thomas M. Sutter 1, Alain Ryser 1, Bernhard Schölkopf 2, Julius von Kügelgen 3, Julia E. Vogt 1
arxiv-2502-06314.description: Abstract Predicting masked from visible parts of an image is a powerful self-supervised approach for visual representation learning. However, the common practice of masking random patches of pixels exhibits certain failure modes, which can prevent learning meaningful high-level features, as required for downstream tasks.

arxiv-2508-10193.title: Mo’ Memory, Mo’ Problems: Stream-Native Machine Unlearning
arxiv-2508-10193.creator: Kennon Stewart
arxiv-2508-10193.description: Abstract Machine unlearning work assumes a static, i.i.d training environment that doesn’t truly exist. Modern ML pipelines need to learn, unlearn, and predict continuously on production streams of data. We translate batch unlearning to the online setting using notions of regret, sample complexity, and deletion capacity.

pmc-10493157.title: Procedural Sedation in a UAE Emergency Department: Encouraging Informed Decision-Making Through a Patient Information Leaflet
pmc-10493157.creator: Amani Khamis AlBedwawi, Afra Bakheet Almansoori, Muna Abdelaziz Aljasmi, Fatema Salem Al Ameri, Nasser Ahmed, Abdul-Salam Adnan Al Mnaseer, Ismail Mohamed Al Ramahi, Kenneth Charles Dittrich, Hasan Qayyum
pmc-10493157.description: IntroductionProcedural sedation is a common procedure conducted in emergency departments (ED) across the world, which requires patients to receive anesthesia/sedation medication in a controlled environment in order to alleviate pain, anxiety, and suffering, thereby allowing multiple procedures to be completed in a safe and timely manner. We deploy this technique for joint reductions, burns dressings, wound repairs, etc.

pmc-10558425.description: Iron ion is one of the most physiologically important elements in metabolic processes, indispensable for all living systems. Since its excess can lead to severe diseases, new approaches for its monitoring in water samples are urgently needed to meet requirements.

pmc-12534595.title: Hepatitis B virus infection and associated risk factors among mothers attending public health facilities in Bahir Dar, Northwest Ethiopia
pmc-12534595.creator: Mekuanint Geta, Endalew Yizengaw, Kefale Ejigu, Asrat Hailu, Yimtubezinash Woldeamanuel
pmc-12534595.description: Globally, the burden of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a serious health problem for women that could be transmitted to their newborn infants. Screening and treating at an early stage help prevent the spread of this infection and its complications.

pmc-12697049.title: Orthodontic Bracket bonded to Enamel pretreated with Er, Cr: YSGG, silver diamine fluoride and Self-Assembling Peptide P11-4. A Lab-based, SEM Assessment
pmc-12697049.creator: Abdullah A Alnazeh, M Abdullah Kamran, Abdulrahman Alshehri, Wael Awadh
pmc-12697049.description: Objectives:The present study evaluates the shear bond strength (SBS) of metallic brackets bonded to enamel conditioned with Phosphoric acid (PA) and enamel conditioned with Er:Cr: YSGG laser in combination with prophylactic measures, i.e., silver diamine fluoride (SDF) and Self-assembling peptides (P114)Methodology:The present in vitro lab-based study was approved by the ethical board of King Khalid University.

pmc-12984057.title: DNA Aptamer-Functionalized Fluorescent Silica Nanoparticles: A Robust Strategy for Specific Detection and Bioimaging of HER2-Overexpressing Breast Cancer
pmc-12984057.creator: Juntao Tan, Zixi Hu, Da Huang, Suqing Cheng, Lu Chen, Liangliang Min, Jianhong Tu, Zhihua Li
pmc-12984057.description: BackgroundPrecise detection of HER2-positive breast cancer is vital for targeted therapy. This study integrates HER2-specific DNA aptamers with fluorescent silica nanoparticles (FSNPs) to develop a targeted imaging probe.MethodsHER2 aptamer-conjugated FSNPs (HApt-FSNPs) were synthesized and characterized. Specificity was evaluated in HER2-positive/negative cells and tumor sections via flow cytometry and microscopy.

pmc-13003458.title: ADAMTS9-AS2 acts as an epigenetic brake to constrain DNMT3B-mediated CADM2 silencing in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma metastasis
pmc-13003458.creator: Fang-Fang Shen, Dong-Fen Li, Ling-Bei Kong, Jia-Le Li, Shi-Long Ma, Hao-Zhe Jiang, Hao-Ze Yuan, Yan Jin, Zhi-Guo Chen, Xiu-Juan Guo, Gao-Pan Dong, De-Rong Lu, Jia-Teng Zhong
pmc-13003458.description: IntroductionMetastatic recurrence drives dismal survival in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), yet epigenetic mechanisms underlying metastasis remain poorly defined. While DNMT1 and DNMT3A contribute to ESCC pathogenesis, DNMT3B’s role is enigmatic despite frequent dysregulation.MethodsIntegrated methylome-transcriptome profiling comprised genome-wide methylation screening in 5 paired ESCC tumor and adjacent normal tissues.

pmc-13028721.title: Identification of Pathogens and Biological Control of Wheat Fusarium Crown Rot in Xinjiang with Pseudomonas aeruginosa J-7
pmc-13028721.creator: Cuicui Yan, Bin Zhang, Beibei Shi, Yejuan Du, Zheng Liu, Jiafeng Huang, Qinggui Lian
pmc-13028721.description: Wheat Fusarium crown rot (FCR), predominantly caused by Fusarium species, is a devastating fungal disease that severely threatens global wheat production. In this study, we combined phytopathological assays, molecular techniques, and bioinformatic analyses to systematically identify the causal agents of FCR in Xinjiang and to screen for potential biocontrol bacteria.

pmc-13265328.title: Diagnosis and treatment of neurofibromatosis type 1 with malignant transformation and multiple gastrointestinal stromal tumors: a case report and literature review
pmc-13265328.creator: Huabin Wang, Jie Liu, Bin Huang, Zhengwei Lai, Yanfei Fang, Guomiao Fu
pmc-13265328.description: A 51-year-old female patient was diagnosed with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) in 2000 (21 years ago). In 2015 (6 years ago), she underwent surgical resection of a mass in her right upper limb. The tumor was pathologically confirmed as malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST) (considering malignant transformation of neurofibroma) and neurofibroma.

pmc-13408594.title: Sleep and light ecologies of parents with young infants: descriptive findings from the SUNSHINE project
pmc-13408594.creator: Vaida Verhoef, Emma Visser, Karin Smolders, Niki Antypa, Yvonne de Kort

pmc-13426244.title: Parasitic Contamination of Fresh Vegetables Marketed and Cultivated in Small‐Scale Farms in Hosanna Town and Its Surrounding Areas, Hadiya Zone, Ethiopia
pmc-13426244.creator: Gebremedhn Yohannes, Amha Gebremariam, Yoseph Baraki, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13426244.description: Fresh vegetables are important components of a healthy diet but may serve as vehicles for transmission of intestinal parasites when contaminated during production, harvesting, transport, and marketing. This study assessed the prevalence and distribution of parasitic contamination in fresh vegetables cultivated on small‐scale farms and marketed through wholesale and retail outlets in Hosanna town and surrounding areas.

pmc-13469304.title: EV-A71 induces GSDME-dependent T-cell pyroptosis: A novel mechanism and MeCbl therapeutic potential
pmc-13469304.creator: Chong Wang, Bingyu Guo, Yilin Li, Xi Zhou, Zongqiang Cui, Yujie Ren
pmc-13469304.description: Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) is the primary pathogen causing severe hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD) in young children, with T-cell immune dysfunction closely linked to severe clinical outcomes. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying EV-A71-mediated T-cell impairment remain unclear, and no specific therapies are currently available. Here, we investigated the interaction between EV-A71 and T cells, and explored potential targeted therapeutic strategies.

uslaw-usc-t2-s196.title: 2 U.S.C. § 196 — Senate resolutions for investigations; limit of cost
uslaw-usc-t2-s196.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s196.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 6 (Congressional And Committee Procedure; Investigations). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Senate resolutions providing for inquiries and investigations shall contain a limit of cost of such investigation, which limit shall not be exceeded except by vote of the Senate authorizing additional amounts.
